name: Aalto Local LLM Gateway
description: Aalto University's single-model gateway for teaching.
overview: Aalto University runs a local LLM gateway for teaching and research, currently exposing Qwen3 32B. Prompts and responses are not logged and usage metadata is recorded, but no explicit no-training rule or metadata-retention period is published.
free_access: Prompts and responses are not logged
notes: Only one model is exposed and access is campus-restricted.
